valid-elementary.text:
description: synthetic nested rate witness
units: {length: cm, quantity: mol, activation-energy: J/mol, pressure: Pa}
phases:
- name: gas
  thermo: ideal-gas
  species: all
  reactions: all
species:
- name: A
  composition: {H: 2}
- name: B
  composition: {H: 2}
reactions:
- equation: A => B
  rate-constant: {A: 1.0, b: 0.0, Ea: 0.0}

cases.rationale: Ordinary required A/Ea and optional b normalize without changing the one-reaction inventory.
Valid high/low rates and all four Troe parameters retain modeled falloff admission.
Two distinct pressures retain a valid flattened pressure-rate entry and sorted grid.
Unknown B must be refused rather than silently replacing the intended exponent with default b=0.
Per-rate units are outside supported document units; do not silently ignore model-bearing scaling.
UNCHANGED required-field control: Ea has no default, so lowercase ea leaves Ea missing. This does not forecast silently lost activation.
Orders belong to the reaction, not RawRate; refuse misplaced scientific meaning.
Unknown capability assertion in high-pressure RawRate must not disappear.
Low-pressure RawRate must independently refuse unsupported local units.
Unknown t2 must be refused rather than dropping an intended optional T2 parameter.
RawPressureRate flattened RawRate must refuse unsupported local pressure units.
A later flattened pressure entry must not silently swallow misplaced reaction orders.

scope: Prospective source-informed nested-rate CLI admission engineering controls; three positive witnesses, eight unknown-modeled-key refusals, one unchanged missing-Ea refusal. No execution performed when frozen.
limits: Not blind chemistry evidence, physical calibration, rates/solver validation, or universal YAML conformance.
Unknown-field refusal expectations derive from the public supported-subset boundary; source inspection indicates missing capture on RawRate/RawTroe, but outcomes are not yet observed.
Original fifty, supplement twenty and existing fifteen CLI controls remain immutable and independent.
An unknown-field failure does not automatically prescribe a source change; adjudicate against contract and preserve first outcomes before repairs.
This collector requires the exact already-built candidate binary. A later repaired source needs a separate explicitly bound collector/manifest revision without rewriting first outcomes.
